proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken.count
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell text says 'A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.' This per-turn cap on activations of the damage reduction is not expressible on the current reduce_damage_taken atom. The parallel field on modify_roll_numeric (count: number) directly covers this pattern.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

notes: The primary mechanic (reduce damage taken by 1d4 for a cast-time chosen damage type, concentration 1 min, touch) encodes cleanly with the existing reduce_damage_taken atom and CastTimeChoice<DamageType>. The only gap is the once-per-turn limiter: reduce_damage_taken has no count field, unlike modify_roll_numeric which already has one. The JSON typechecks and the tracer produces a valid graph; the encoding is honest about what it expresses and omits only the per-turn cap.
